name: Normal Operation and Manual Control
description: The simplest of the five - good for opening a demo. Resting state, a device closes on command with real permission/feedback confirmation, an event log entry, then it opens again and everything returns to normal.

steps.description: Resting state: everything green, nominal voltage

Close command for the main isolator (DO01) - the exact same permission/interlock path a real Force button uses. Feedback confirms the state change immediately (see Digital Inputs / Control Outputs), and the command is recorded on the Events page.
Open command - the device returns to its resting state
